name: v2 sudo activity burst
description: Three or more Falco sudo-execution events in one container within 10 minutes. Grouped by container id, not host.name: every Falco event carries the lab's one host name, and sudo events carry no container name, so the old key merged every sudo in the lab into one alert (#1497). Not per user: Falco records sudo's user as root (sudo is setuid) and no login user inside the lab's containers, so a burst groups every identity's sudo on that host; the host's auth.log names who ran each command. Concentrated sudo bursts capture legitimate oncall response and change work (sre.* and service identities) and interactive attacker activity post-shell. Rule fires regardless of hour; the off-hours-vs-work-hours distinction is left to investigation analysis via the alert @timestamp. Triage answers which identity drove the burst, what change-mgmt window was active (if any), and whether the host is currently in an incident state.
